characters.label: Hunting Grounds · Elder sans masque · garde native

accepted.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: one full-body transparent 2D fighting-game character portrait. Input reference is the OFFICIAL PS4 Pro screenshot of the ELDER CLASS in Predator: Hunting Grounds published by PlayStation on June12 2020. Recreate that game's unmasked Elder appearance as closely as possible, NOT a new elder and NOT a generic ornate tribal fantasy hunter.
Preserve the aged pale gray/tan face and forehead pattern, FOUR separate external mouth mandibles with visible teeth and small piercings, black/gray beaded dreadlocks, lean muscular spotted tan skin under black diamond body netting, the compact layered dark-silver armor on his anatomical LEFT chest and shoulder, the much smaller right shoulder protection, the diagonal reddish-brown patterned leather bandolier, bone/bead and small skull necklace, segmented waist protection and leather pouches. Left forearm has its rectangular red-display computer; right forearm has its strapped wrist-blade housing with TWO short retracted blade tips. Keep the compact plasma caster over the anatomical LEFT shoulder, never duplicated. Hands empty, coherent five digits including thumb. Any sheathed belt accessory remains small and faithful, no sword in hands.
Full body in calm combat-ready stance facing SCREEN RIGHT, readable side-on three-quarter view and waist-level camera. Two legs, two arms, clawed bare feet planted on a common baseline. Hidden shins and back are restrained reconstruction: worn plain dark-metal shin plates and existing netting, no new ornament. Match asymmetrical armor placement and correct anatomical sides. Body proportions realistic, not chibi. Detailed painted game sprite with clear silhouette, restrained neutral lighting, no dramatic colored light.
Portrait canvas 1024x1536. Entire silhouette including dreadlocks, fingertips, equipment and toes fits within at least70px transparent margins, about82 percent canvas height. One character only. True transparent alpha background; no backdrop, floor, shadow, text, labels, logo, watermark, border, references or additional figures.
accepted.visualNotes: Complete coherent silhouette inspected, anatomical left computer/caster and right wrist blades retained; reconstruction limits declared.

Make exactly SIX separately drawn frames of a calm breathing guard cycle in a 3-column by 2-row grid on a1536x1024 canvas: six512x512 cells, reading left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No visible grid or labels.
CRITICAL full-body framing: each character must be NO MORE THAN370px tall inside its cell, head roughlyy80, solesy450. At least48px of truly empty transparent space on ALL cell edges, including feet and longest equipment. Put each body at x256 with the same scale and planted foot locations throughout. Never crop fingers, toes, dreads or shoulder cannon. Six DISTINCT poses: subtle chest inhalation then exhalation, knee settling, elbow adjustment, small coherent hand motion and dreadlock follow-through, returning to start. No walking, jumps, attacks or costume changes.
Use clear lateral three-quarter combat orientation, opponent at the named screen side. Draw natural anatomy: exactly two arms, two legs and coherent five-digit clawed hands with thumbs, no fused palms. Correct fixed anatomical equipment sides: LEFT shoulder single plasma caster and larger layered pauldron, LEFT forearm red-display wrist computer, RIGHT forearm strapped housing with only TWO SHORT RETRACTED blade tips. Empty hands, no held gun/sword or new prop. This is an authored orientation, NEVER a horizontal mirror of the master. Armor and weapon sides remain anatomically correct when the body rotates.
Detailed painted game sprite, neutral even lighting, readable silhouette. Six separate complete silhouettes with matching body size. Genuine transparent alpha background. No floor, shadow, halo, smoke, glow, text, watermarks, logos, backdrop, frame or extra reference thumbnail.
Identity: the UNMASKED ELDER CLASS of Predator: Hunting Grounds, with the same aged patterned gray/tan forehead, FOUR exterior mandibles, orange eyes, dark gray cuffed dreadlocks, diamond netting, patterned reddish leather bandolier and small skull/bead necklace from Image1. Left chest layered silver armor, right chest mostly netted. Preserve face—not a human, ogre or generic monster. Do not add a helmet.
ALL SIX FRAMES FACE SCREEN RIGHT. Head, shoulders and forward toes read clearly toward RIGHT, torso at about55degrees from camera. No frame looks straight at camera or opposite direction. Draw this actual view rather than flipping the other side. Front plane equipment may occlude the far wrist naturally; do not transplant it.
MANDATORY CORRECTION FROM REJECTED ATTEMPT: figures were too large and touched horizontal cell boundaries, cutting toes and tops. BODY HEIGHT ONLY330PIXELS. There must be at least80pixels of fully transparent vertical separation between top-row feet and bottom-row heads. Never enlarge to fill the grid! Six complete SMALLER characters with very large transparent margins, atlas1536x1024.
IMAGE3 IS ONLY A SAFE SPACING/SCALE EXAMPLE from another fighter. Follow its empty cell margins and isolated complete silhouettes. Do NOT copy its costume, mask or military camouflage; identity remains Image1 and Image2. Every pixel outside the six silhouettes must be fully transparent, not smoky gradients or shadows. Distinct breathing pose in each cell, very generous empty space mandatory.
